prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Denver for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on your case (simple single implant vs full-arch, bone grafting needed, medical issues) and your priorities (price, speed, sedation, cosmetic outcome). I can search for highly rated providers near you, but first a few quick questions so I can give a useful recommendation:

- Are you in Denver proper or a particular suburb/ZIP code?  
- Do you have dental insurance or a network preference?  
- Is this a straightforward single-tooth implant or a more complex case (bone graft, sinus lift, full-arch/All-on-4)?  
- Do you prefer a specialist (oral surgeon, periodontist, prosthodontist) or a general dentist who places implants?

How to choose a top implant provider (what to look for)
- Specialty and training: oral & maxillofacial surgeons, periodontists, and prosthodontists are the specialists most experienced with implants. Many general dentists also place implants after advanced training.  
- Experience with your specific procedure: ask how many similar cases they’ve done.  
- CBCT 3D imaging and digital planning: important for accurate placement and safety.  
- Use of surgical guides and high-quality implant systems (Straumann, Nobel, Zimmer, etc.).  
- Before/after photos and patient references.  
- Clear treatment plan, breakdown of costs, timeline, and options for sedation.  
- Good reviews on Google/Yelp/Healthgrades and membership in professional groups (AAOMS, AAP, ACP).  
- Post-op support and warranty/guarantee policies.

If you want, I can:
- Look up top-rated implant specialists in Denver (give me your ZIP/area and any insurance/network info), or  
- Provide a short checklist and sample questions to bring to consultations.

Which would you prefer?
